test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word.**

The workers’ Interests must be protected, _______ they will go on a strike.
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Else**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the above-given sentence, '**else**' will be used.
 
• **Else **is an **adverb **that means **instead; if not**.
 
 
• For Example - Leave or **else **you'll be sorry.
 
 
 
• The given sentence expresses the fact that the workers' interests must be protected, if not, then they will go on a strike.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

**Correct Sentence - ***The workers’ Interests must be protected, **else__ **they will go on a strike.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **or **usage **of the other words given in options:-

 
 
• **And **- used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.
 
• **So **- to such a great extent.
 
• **But **- used to introduce a phrase or clause contrasting with what has already been mentioned.
